description: Get ~10 years of daily bars, trailing returns, distance off the period high, and month-by-month seasonality for any ticker — no API key required. Use when locating a name in its own cycle, checking whether a move is unusual for it, testing a seasonality claim against data instead of eyeballing a chart, or when a price series is needed and the usual free endpoints are blocked.
